title: Cracked Knight of Ruin
description: A half-armored warrior stands against a stormy sky, his body literally split down the middle. The left side shows pale cracked porcelain-like skin and white armor with runes, while the right side is a blackened crumbling form glowing with molten orange cracks and emitting dark smoke and embers.
prompt: A dramatic half-and-half portrait of a knight whose body is split vertically. The left side is pale white with cracked porcelain texture, silver rune-etched helmet and armor, flowing grey cloak. The right side is completely blackened and crumbling with glowing orange lava-like cracks, burning eye, and dark smoke pouring from the fractures. He holds a spear, dramatic stormy sky with purple and yellow lightning in the background, dark fantasy style, highly detailed
